5. [P2] BIPL-MUX-7174 (College Road) - UPS_ON_BATTERY, open 43 min -> confirm generator changeover before the UPS drains
6. [P4] AKBL-MUX-4493 (College Road) - PRINTER_PAPER_OUT, open 224 min -> add to the custodian's next routine visit
